expected_structural_delta: No new owner, module, dependency, representation, protocol or persisted setting. One validator correction and focused regressions.
minimum_design: Repair only the inert validation container home config parent after exact runner identity checks; reject symlinks and retain real graphroot/build/cleanup checks.
outcome: Run native pooled Podman qualification with the same non-root cache-parent ownership as normal runner startup.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing native validator and image home preparation
reuse_decisions.rationale: Normal wait-docker startup repairs Docker-created XDG parents. Inert validation bypasses startup; its existing identity probe can prepare the config parent without changing production provisioning or shared cache contents.
